i.norm: Verifies that consumeCssIdentifier() replaces a NULL character (U+0000) with the Unicode REPLACEMENT CHARACTER (U+FFFD), and stops consuming at the first whitespace. Input queue: "b" + U+0000 + "L (" -- two letters around a NULL, followed by a space and paren. The space terminates the CSS identifier, so only "b" + U+FFFD + "L" is returned.
NULL (U+0000) is embedded between 'b' and 'L'; the trailing " (" ends the identifier.
Per CSS input preprocessing, U+0000 is replaced by U+FFFD (REPLACEMENT CHARACTER). Consumption stops at the space, so the result is: 'b', replacement char, 'L'.
